features.title: Toolkit Install, Signed Owner Initialization & Status
features.description: Initializes a project for the agent-specified environment: places the pre-generated Framework, Copilot and Guard skills, creates the empty layout and host-entry fragment, lets the owner explicitly initialize signed Maintainer authorization, and reports status separately.

features.title: Local Knowledge Maintenance & Changelog
features.description: Authorized Maintainers import and edit Local rules by namespace/source-version/rule-ID with one current content, full changelog, examples, partial and idempotent batch import, pre-check and consistent single-record writes.

features.title: Policy Resolution & Adoption Scope Selection
features.description: Resolves formal Local Policies into structured output, checks availability, and lets the user confirm the adopted scope via clues, no clues, or Apply All without Presets.

features.title: Knowledge Exit Impact & Broken-Link Handling
features.description: Maintainer-initiated deactivate, delete or rename shows an impact list first, reports broken references without silent substitution, invalidates known dependent caches and leaves historical reports untouched.

features.title: Reference Knowledge Exploration & Cache
features.description: Phase 2: explores maintained Reference sources only within registered domains, prefers formal Local content, and caches results for 7 days with explicit refresh.

features.title: Presets & Tags
features.description: Phase 2: reusable Presets holding concrete rule references with query intent and snapshot_at, plus JSON tags for lookup that never change severity or Presets implicitly.

features.title: AI-assisted Knowledge Drafting
features.description: Phase 2: AI drafts examples and explanations for specified rules, clearly labelled, validated and approved by a Maintainer before entering formal knowledge.

features.title: Guard Semantic Verification & Verdict Reporting
features.description: Guard verifies formed artifacts against adopted Policies through a check plan and semantic review, re-checks findings with an independent Reviewer, and reports a three-state verdict with a four-state ledger and evidence.

features.title: Adapter Contract & Opengrep Adapter
features.description: Defines the shared Adapter contract in Framework scripts and delivers the Opengrep Adapter with pre-check, typed parameters and normalized results, measured on the MVP samples.

features.title: Verification Budget, Cancel & Data-Egress Control
features.description: One shared budget per verification, user cancellation with honest partial results, and purpose-specific network and data-submission authorization for every outbound call.

features.title: Trivy Adapter
features.description: Trivy Adapter for dependency, container, configuration and secret checks under the shared contract, with vulnerability-DB updates only under explicit update authorization.

features.title: Strix Adapter with Original-Project Protection
features.description: Strix Adapter that first proves read-only access to the original project or else runs on an explicit working copy, within budget and egress authorization.

features.title: Temporary Check Scripts
features.description: Phase 2: one-off helper check scripts generated only for real gaps, reviewed with known positive/negative samples and executed under actual limits.

features.title: Cross-run Report Comparison
features.description: Phase 3: on explicit request compares two specified Guard reports as new, still present, not observed this time, or not comparable.

features.title: Copilot In-flow Suggestions & Adoption Review
features.description: Copilot gives concrete Policy-based suggestions during design, implementation, bug fix and refactor, then an independent read-only Reviewer checks adoption and the result is reported.

features.title: Single-source Host Integration Carriers
features.description: Generates system-prompt fragment, AGENTS.md entry and GitHub instructions from one routing definition, extending the minimal fragment written by FEATURE-001-A, with maintainer-decided differences.

features.title: Development Sandbox & MVP Acceptance Harness
features.description: Maintainer sandbox for candidate skills plus fixed normal and negative acceptance cases and cross-Adapter evaluation on the marathon and WebGoat samples.

features.title: Bounded Improvement Suggestions & Lessons
features.description: Phase 3: strictly admitted improvement suggestions, at most 10 active, 30-day expiry and terminal retention, mandatory review of user suggestions.

features.title: Controlled Autonomous Optimization
features.description: Phase 3: explicitly triggered optimization from at most 3 Lessons under a separately signed autonomy policy; only low-risk local changes auto-apply, others stay candidates.
